card.name: Abstract nouns and modifiers in explanatory prose
card.fires_on: Mid-sentence content words in general explanatory or news prose, such as adverbs, adjectives and abstract nouns (atically, calculus, illness, opposition, new). The word usually sits before a connecting phrase or a noun that continues the thought.

card.writes: Weak and mixed; it nudges toward vivid, descriptive wording (inspiring, flavours) but the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on ordinary descriptive words in explanatory writing, mostly where the sentence is about to continue.
